entries.name: Windows Desktop (Terminator)
entries.description: Computer use: drive real Windows apps (WeChat, Excel, native tools) via the UI Automation accessibility tree — click, type, and read controls by name/role. Attended by default: every actuating tool requires approval and is CAP-floored in unattended runs. Off until you enable it.

entries.name: Computer Use (screen + mouse + keyboard)
entries.description: Computer use: screenshot the desktop and drive mouse/keyboard on any Windows app (UIA with a pixel fallback). Attended by default — actuating tools require approval. Off until you enable it.

entries.name: Playwright Browser
entries.description: Headless Chromium driving via Playwright. Lets the agent navigate URLs, click elements, and snapshot pages.

entries.name: Filesystem
entries.description: Read + write files inside the current workspace. Defaults to the project root; pass an explicit directory in args to scope it.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Read repositories, open PRs, manage issues. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in the env block to authenticate.

entries.name: Postgres
entries.description: Run read-only queries against a Postgres database. Replace the placeholder connection string in args, then enable.

entries.name: SQLite
entries.description: Query a SQLite database file. Replace the placeholder path in args with your `.sqlite` file, then enable.

entries.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
entries.description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory the agent can write to and recall from across turns.

entries.name: HTTP Fetch
entries.description: Fetch arbitrary URLs and convert them to Markdown for grounded reading.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Read channels, messages, and threads, and post messages. Set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN + SLACK_TEAM_ID in the env block. (Slack ingest into your brain is configured separately under Connections.)
